witness.description: Finite witness set for the exact rational verifier, embedded as a pure-Python literal. Verifier recomputes 2^n exactly by integer arithmetic, derives ternary digits by divmod, and fails closed on any non-integer, negative, bool, or duplicated exponent. No imports, no I/O, no floats.

claim: FRAGMENT: certifies the checkable core of lemma 'certifier' — a deterministic, offline, fail-closed verifier in pure CPython stdlib (no imports, no I/O, no floats, no network, no filesystem) exists; it recomputes 2^n exactly by integer division, derives ternary digits exactly, aborts (returns False) on any non-integer, negative, bool-typed, or duplicated exponent, and returns True only when every expected {0,1}-ternary verdict is exactly confirmed (including the negative case n=10: 1024 = 1101221_3 contains digit 2). RESULT == True on the embedded witness. Does NOT close close-branch A; covers='fragment'.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
